og.title: 19th Century Japanese Woodblock Prints Creatively Illustrate the Inner Workings of the Human Body
og.description: Folks with a passing knowledge of ukiyo-e, the Japanese woodblock print art form popular in the 17th through 19th centuries, will be familiar with its landscapes, as well as its portraits of courtesans and kabuki actors.
